newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK77 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK77 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said it sold 76.8 million kuna in 91-day treasury bills at a primary auction on Tuesday.
It had planned to raise 100 million kuna but bids fell short of the target, it said.

The issued price rose to 97.567 from 97.461 percent five weeks ago with the rate easing 15 basis points to 10 percent. Banking investors bought around 75 percent of the issue. Bills are payable in two days and mature on October 30.
Croatia has 511.3 million kuna in outstanding 42-, 91- and 182-day T-bills.
The ministry set the next auction for August 12, when it will seek to raise 40 million kuna through a new 182-day issue.
Foreigners have no direct access to these auctions but can place their bids with Croatian banks.
